title: Anitta avoids talking about romance with Danilo Mesquita
seoTitle: Anitta avoids talking about romance with Danilo Mesquita
subtitle: The singer and the actor keep their distance from the subject amid rumors
excerpt: Anitta and Danilo Mesquita were spotted together in Niterói, sparking speculation. The singer prefers not to comment on her personal life, focusing on work.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the night of last Saturday, the 22nd, Anitta and Danilo Mesquita appeared together in Niterói, before the "Equilibrivm" tour show, fueling dating rumors. The 33-year-old singer was questioned by journalists backstage and chose not to comment on the alleged relationship. "I prefer not to talk about my personal life at this moment," she stated, citing a previous interview in which the actor had asked if she was single. Her response ended up being the only talking point on the matter.

Anitta remains focused on work

During the interview, Anitta emphasized that, when accepting fame, attention to her daily life is inevitable, but that her focus now is on the tour project and other work. She highlighted that the project's theme can help many people and that she does not want attention to drift solely to her love life. "It's not because no one should know, it's normal. But right now the focus is on this work," she said.

Danilo Mesquita also avoids the subject

The 34-year-old actor was spotted at the same show and also avoided answering questions about the relationship. On other occasions, he dodged questions about Anitta when leaving Estúdios Globo. The affair rumors began a few weeks ago, but both maintain the stance of neither confirming nor denying.

Careers on the rise

Danilo Mesquita has already starred in the Globo telenovelas "Rock Star" and "Além da Ilusão" and, on October 9, will return in the second season of "Amor da Minha Vida," a Disney+ series, alongside Bruna Marquezine. Anitta, for her part, is in the midst of her "Equilibrivm" tour and already has shows scheduled in Salvador and at the Rock The Mountain festival in Itaipava.

Rumors and the role of the media

The two have been the subject of media speculation, but maintain their stance of not commenting publicly on the alleged relationship. The singer also did not comment on other news, such as the possibility of being the next drum queen of Grande Rio, focusing only on the upcoming shows of her tour.

Conclusion

While the rumors continue, Anitta and Danilo Mesquita keep their focus on work, avoiding discussions about their personal lives. Expectations remain high surrounding their upcoming performances and appearances, with the public eagerly awaiting the next steps in each of their careers.

With information from CNN Brasil, Globo.com, Folha PE.
